findings.title: Use of helper function not aligned with module style
findings.body: The new helper `_percentage` is introduced to avoid code duplication, but the module previously handled the same logic inline (lines 5–7 removed). The module’s existing style did not use helper functions for this pattern, so introducing one now violates naming consistency (rule 1 of *Naming Consistency*).

summary.done_well: The refactor consolidates duplicated percentage logic into a single helper, reducing code duplication.
